decisions: Treat Coinbase as a major institutional XRP infrastructure provider: custodian in five ETF custodian sets, prime broker for Franklin, Prime Execution Agent for Bitwise, Trade Credit Lender for Bitwise and Bitwise's principal market for GAAP NAV at June30 2026.
Do not equate 1.1422B XRP held by funds whose custodian set includes Coinbase with Coinbase's actual custody balance; multi-custodian allocation is undisclosed.
Treat Coinbase trade credit as a secured short-term contractual facility, not proof of outstanding borrowing. The Agent Execution Model is rare; Trust-Directed Trade Model is normal.
Record Coinbase's first-priority lien and default liquidation rights as a contingent collateral pathway; no default or current encumbrance is established.
Treat Ripple Markets' $220.676M 21Shares seed investment as ETF-share capital, not an equivalent direct XRP spot purchase. The Dec20 2026 date is a share lock-up milestone, not an XRP escrow release.
Separate cash creations from in-kind creations and cash redemptions from in-kind redemptions; ETF creations are not always exchange-market purchases.

Use SEC fund-level XRP inventory and cash capital transactions as actual fund-level evidence, keeping funds and periods separate: Bitwise H1 net inventory +155.615M XRP; 21Shares H1 net inventory -27.303M XRP and net cash capital -$49.501M.
Do not add ETF custody holdings to XRP Insights exchange-wallet totals; ETF custody vaults without public exchange labels are excluded.
Flag the 1.6M Binance-Peg reserve discrepancy and lack of per-wallet history; exchange balances remain custody context, not customer flows or tradable float.
No directional feature is admitted and no forecast is issued.
next_tests: Extract historical cash and in-kind creations/redemptions for all six US spot XRP ETFs.
Search subsequent Bitwise filings for Coinbase Credit drawdowns, outstanding balances, fees, defaults or amended limits.
Obtain same-date custodian allocation for multi-custodian ETFs if publicly disclosed.
Track Ripple Markets seed-share lock-up through Dec20 2026 without assuming redemption.
Reconcile Binance-Peg 325.8M versus 327.4M and preserve no-per-wallet-history limitation.
